tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rta mgrin dbang gi zab pa las/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bde chen rang 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 1$0000300chags med pad+ma'i rigs bdag snang mtha' yas// gsung gi dbang phyug phyag na pad+mo 'chang*// gsang ba kun gyi mdzod 'dzin rdo rje chos// gsol ba 'debs so dbang bzhi'i ye shes stsol// dga' chen dbang gi lha mo tsan+dha lī// rgyal kun gsung 'dzin 'phags pa klu sgrub zhabs// spyan ras gzigs dngos mi tra dzo gi la// gsol ba 'debs so dbang bzhi'i ye shes stsol// rgyal ba gnyis pa dpal ldan pad+ma skyes// tshe dbang nus 'byin lha yi lcam gcig ma// bka' yi sdud po dbyangs can mtsho rgyal la// gsol ba 'debs so dbang bzhi'i ye shes stsol// bstan pa'i shing rta chos rgyal yab sras dang*// dbang chen bka' bab rgyal ba mchog dbyangs zhabs// chos kyi blo gros ār+ya sa le la// gsol ba 'debs so dbang bzhi'i ye shes stsol// zab gter sgo 'byed mchog gyur bde chen gling*// lung zin bka' bab chos kyi bdag po sogs// gsung mchog grub pa'i rig pa 'dzin rnams la// gsol ba 'debs so dbang bzhi'i ye shes stsol// dbang chen rta mchog rgyal po khrag 'thung bzhi// zil gnon rnam brgyad sgo srung pho nya sogs// dkyil 'khor bka' sdod phyag brnyan bcas pa la// gsol ba 'debs so dbang bzhi'i ye shes stsol// zab mo'i dbang gis rgyud smin dam tshig brtan// bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhis bskyed rim mthar phyin zhing*// spros bcas spros med rdzogs rim lam du longs// dbang chen rol pa'i phyag rgya myur 'grub shog /ka dag lta bas ye shes dbyings nas skul// lhun grub sgom pas dam can gnad la dbab// la zla'i spyod pas dregs pa las la skul// rta skad thengs gsum dgongs pa mthar phyin shog /rlung sems snang ba mtha' dag rang dbang 'dus// 'bar ba'i gar gyis gzhan snang zil gyis gnon// bde chen rab 'bar dbang gi dkyil 'khor du// snang srid gzhir rdzogs chen por byang chub shog
ces pa'ang mchims phu dben rtsa mchog dbyangs phug dbang chen rol pa'i tshogs khang chen por bsnyen sgrub 'brel 'jog bgyis pa'i tshe pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug rtsal gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel// //
